subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff: Lighthouse Labs — template choice & signer roster
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lighthouselabs.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lighthouselabs.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff — getting docs over

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the chat earlier. Per our discussion we've attached our draft order form (LighthouseLabs_Initial_OrderForm_v1.pdf) and a simple signer matrix (LL_signatory_matrix.xlsx). We're open to using Redwood's MSA template if that's faster for you — however, we do have a few standard clauses (data residency + export controls) that our legal team will want to preserve.

Quick asks to start the intake: 
- Can Redwood confirm which MSA template you prefer to start from (standard vs. EU-residency variant)?
- Do you need SOC 2 evidence up front or can that come with the security questionnaire?
- We propose an initial 60-day onboarding/implementation milestone in the order form — can you confirm whether your billing cadence supports a mid-quarter activation?

I've attached the files and copied procurement. Would like to get a first pass from your contracts team by EOD Thursday so we can line up an internal review next week.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Head of Procurement — Lighthouse Labs
Attachments: LighthouseLabs_Initial_OrderForm_v1.pdf (pdf), LL_signatory_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lighthouselabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff — getting docs over

Alex — thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. Looping in Kimberly (contracts) and Marissa (onboarding) to kickoff intake. Quick answers below and next steps.

1) Template: Redwood's standard MSA will be faster in most cases. We have an "EU-residency" addendum variant if you need data-residency commitments. If you share the specific residency language you need we can slot it into our standard MSA and keep the rest of the text intact.

2) SOC 2 evidence: Kimberly, please confirm, but we typically can surface a SOC 2 summary + Atlassian-style evidence bundle via our security portal; the full report is available under NDA. That should be OK for intake.

3) Billing cadence and milestone: Marissa — our billing team can do prorated mid-cycle activations. We'll capture the 60-day onboarding milestone in the order form as a deliverable and set billing to start on go-live.

Next steps (action items):
- Kimberly to do first-pass redlines on the attached Order Form and advise on any material MSA asks (target: 2026-07-15 EOD).
- Sean to confirm any non-standard commercial flags (discounts / offsets) — none at kickoff unless you tell us otherwise.
- Marissa to confirm onboarding timeline and owner contact for implementation.

If it's helpful I can also share our standard MSA + the EU addendum link now and mark the clauses we think will map to your asks.

Thanks,
Sean
Director, Contracts & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lighthouselabs.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff — getting docs over

Hi Alex — I reviewed the order form and signer matrix. A few items to flag from a contracting intake perspective: 

- Order form: your revenue definition includes "per-seat" and "API call" metrics. We need to agree on the primary metering for billing (recommended: API token units as defined in Exhibit B). If you prefer seat+API hybrid, propose we map seats to a minimum commitment and API to overage.

- Data residency: I see the clause you pasted into the order form references "EU processing only" for a subset of customers. Please confirm which business units require EU-only residency; if it's company-wide we'll route to our EU addendum.

- Liability cap: your redline suggests a higher cap for critical regulatory events. Our standard MSA has a mutual cap equal to 12 months' fees; if you need more than that we'll need to run this through legal + finance approval.

- Standard redlines: I attached inline comments to the OrderForm PDF in Drive (link in related_links). I'm attaching a short intake checklist: we need the signatory names / titles filled out for the signer matrix (we can accept a scanned signature page later).

Action items and owners: 
- Alex / Lighthouse: mark which BU's require EU residency and confirm primary billing metric (due: 2026-07-16).
- Kimberly (contracts): will produce first-pass redlines on the Order Form + identify any MSA exceptions that need Leadership/Finance review (target: 2026-07-15 EOD).
- Marissa (onboarding): please provide the technical owner to coordinate the 60-day milestone and confirm the proposed go-live window.

Note on SOC 2: we'll put together the security portal link. For intake, summary evidence + the questionnaire response should be sufficient. Full SOC 2 report available after NDA if you need it for procurement.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Contracts & Risk
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: inline comments in Drive, intake checklist (link)

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@lighthouselabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@lighthouselabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff — getting docs over

Thanks Kimberly — good, clear flags. Quick replies inline: 

- EU residency scope: only our EU product delivery team (EU Ops) needs guaranteed EU-only processing. I'll send a short note from our EU Ops lead confirming the BU list by tomorrow (2026-07-15).
- Billing metric: we're fine adopting API token units as primary meter for the order form. We'll put a minimum monthly commitment in seats as you suggested.
- Liability cap: understood — if Finance requests >12 months we'll let you know but for now we accept standard and will surface exceptions after our internal review.

I'll upload a signed (scanned) signer matrix by EOD Friday and share the EU Ops confirmation. Also happy for you to start with Redwood's standard MSA + EU addendum placeholder and add your inline comments.

Next steps for me: upload signer matrix; confirm EU BU list; review Kimberly's inline redlines.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Alex
Head of Procurement — Lighthouse Labs

--- THREAD FOOTER ---\nNotes: Drive folder contains: 1) LighthouseLabs_Initial_OrderForm_v1.pdf (with Kimberly's inline comments), 2) LL_signatory_matrix.xlsx (pending scanned signatures), 3) Redwood_Standard_MSA_v3.2.pdf and EU_Addendum_placeholder.docx.
